title: Familiar channels
mechanism: selected WhatsApp sources plus uploads; Gmail added for legal workflow. Preserve source coverage and connector health separately from processing status.
test: disconnect, replay, expired media, edited/deleted messages, partial backfill. No silent completeness claim.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Business understanding
mechanism: contextual interpretation, identities, versioned episode membership, alternative interpretations, correction dependencies.
test: two crates short / remaining came / other outlet / revised invoice; ordinary complete delivery; two same-name people.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Owner commands
mechanism: explicit request record, authority, intended scope, progress, cancellation and outcome; read/question/create/update operations share business context.
test: ask status, assign work, correct quantity, create a document, supersede an instruction; duplicate client submission creates one logical request.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Ordinary work and proactive attention
mechanism: quiet successful processing under policy; attention only for decisions, exceptions and relevant changes. Unlinked evidence remains discoverable.
test: normal delivery needs no unnecessary clarification; no fabricated exception; unanswered useful request remains visible.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Voice and mixed media
mechanism: original assets, transcript/translation/regions/timestamps; critical-number and negation validation; modality-specific capability checks.
test: actual staff languages, code-switching, background noise, blurry photos, conflicting audio and invoice; no hidden inference that a photo proves payment.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Phone and desktop continuity
mechanism: shared server state, pending local requests, durable request IDs, version checks, visible offline/queued/synced/conflicted states.
test: request on phone, continue desktop, disconnect, edit on both, revoke access before reconnect. No automatic stale privileged action.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Authentication and permissions
mechanism: enrollment, selected sources, scoped grants, expired-credential recovery, staff removal, device revocation, credential isolation.
test: remove manager while a review card is open; reconnect source without silently broadening scope; CA sees only authorized businesses.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Useful tools and artifacts
mechanism: narrow tools with input/output schemas, provenance, versioned artifacts and private delivery. Existing stock/accounting field authority preserved.
test: generate receiving report/PDF; verify fields against saved records; inspect corrected source after generation; sharing is a separate authorized action.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Work completion
mechanism: assignment, acknowledgement, blockers, timers, completion report, closure evidence and reopening.
test: restart before reminder; duplicate completion message; unauthorized closure; later evidence contradicts closure.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Learning
mechanism: separate case corrections, identity aliases, approved business policies and product changes.
test: exception for one delivery does not alter supplier-wide policy; correction invalidates affected results without exposing other tenants.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Secure cloud and model portability
mechanism: durable shared records, private assets, isolated untrusted parsing, capability/data-policy-qualified model adapters.
test: tenant boundaries, prompt injection in attachment, prohibited parser egress, fallback refusal when model lacks required capability.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Cost and scale
mechanism: per-tenant queues/budgets, bounded retrieval and retries, cached unchanged extraction, selective invalidation, overload visibility.
test: growing history and tenant concurrency; record retrieval recall, correction quality, tail latency, tokens, asset bytes, queue lag and total human effort.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling

title: Legal workflow
mechanism: Gmail notice ingestion, matter identifiers, confidentiality, explicit date provenance, assignment and document follow-through.
test: amended notice, same client with two matters, wrong attachment, revoked matter access, missing explicit deadline. Add after first workflow proof; do not assume restaurant success validates it.

title: Browser, video and native access
mechanism: scoped browser worker; timestamped video observations; device bridge only where needed. Avoid making these prerequisites for the first slice.
test: session leakage, uncertain external action outcomes, temporal video ambiguity, local bridge disconnection and permission withdrawal.

title: Own collaboration and agent exchange
mechanism: future app collaboration and explicitly delegated cross-business jobs with audience limits and receipts.
test: recipient revocation, replay, conflicting agent instructions and disclosure boundaries.

title: Development and commercial proof
mechanism: same real-app execution path for test and product; pinned source evidence; protected fresh cases; baseline work observation; buyer/reviewer ownership; versioned human and LLM docs.
test: clean setup and migration/restore, replay historical defects, compare assisted/manual effort and support cost, distinguish retained evidence from reviewer agreement.
phase: First bounded workflow; qualify before enabling
